import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers using t-statistics and correlation clustering
    t_stats = np.array([stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                       feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)], 
                                       equal_var=False)[0] 
                       for fid in feats.ids])
    
    # Select top features by absolute t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(np.abs(t_stats))[::-1][:20]
    top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Cluster correlated features
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]].T)
    np.fill_diagonal(corr_matrix, 0)
    
    # Use hierarchical clustering to find modules
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2, linkage='ward')
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Find the most correlated cluster
    cluster_sizes = np.bincount(cluster_labels)
    main_cluster = np.argmax(cluster_sizes)
    
    # Get features in the main cluster
    module_features = [top_features[i] for i in range(len(top_features)) 
                      if cluster_labels[i] == main_cluster]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated with r > 0.6)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(module_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(module_features)):
            fid1, fid2 = module_features[i], module_features[j]
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid1)], 
                              feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    final_features = [fid for fid in module_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # If no clear module, return empty design
    if len(final_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score based on standardized values
    weights = np.array([t_stats[feats.column(fid)] for fid in final_features])
    weights = np.abs(weights) / np.sum(np.abs(weights))  # normalize
    
    # Return design with module features and their loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(final_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
        columns=tuple(final_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(final_features, weights))
    )
